description: Storage of the PostgreSQL data or WAL volumes. Follows the same spec as `persistence` with type `pvc`.

size.description: Size of the PVC, for example `256Gi`.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the PVC, as a list or as a single string.

volumeName.description: Name of the PersistentVolume to bind the PVC to.

storageClass.description: Name of the StorageClass to use for the PVC.

dataSource.description: Data source to populate the PVC from.

kind.description: Kind of the data source reference.

name.description: Name of the data source reference.

apiGroup.description: API group of the data source reference.

dataSourceRef.description: Data source reference to populate the PVC from.
